review.tagline: CLI proxy that compresses shell command output before coding agents read it
review.summary: rtk is a single Rust binary that wraps 100+ shell commands (git, cargo test, pytest, docker, kubectl, aws and others) and returns grouped, truncated or deduplicated output. `rtk init` installs a hook for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf and other agents that rewrites Bash calls such as `git status` to `rtk git status`. The README claims up to 90% less bash output and under 10ms overhead.
review.audience: Developers running coding agents who want smaller shell output in context
strengths: Single Rust binary; README states under 10ms overhead per command
Auto-rewrite hook covers many agents: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline
Per-command filters for tests, linters, git, docker, kubectl, AWS and Pulumi
`rtk gain` reports savings history; `rtk discover` finds missed rewrites
weaknesses: Hook only affects Bash calls; Claude's built-in Read, Grep and Glob bypass it
Token counts are estimated as bytes/4; no tokenizer, so absolute numbers are approximate
Up to 90% applies to bash output only, not to the total bill
Another 'rtk' crate exists on crates.io; install via git, not the crate name
needs: Models: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf
